title_zh: 安省考驾照英文指南合集
description_en: A practical English guide to Ontario’s G1, G2 and Full G tests, covering the test process, common instructions, real dialogue examples and essential driving-test vocabulary.
description_zh: 涵盖安省 G1、G2 和 Full G 考试流程、常见考官指令、真实英文对话及重点词汇，帮助你提前熟悉考试场景，听懂指令，减少紧张。

title_zh: 加拿大牙科场景英语合集
description_en: A practical English guide to common dental visits in Canada, covering check-in, dental X-rays, cleaning, fillings, payment, insurance and follow-up appointments, with real-life dialogues and essential dental expressions.
description_zh: 涵盖加拿大常见看牙场景，包括前台登记、拍牙片、洗牙、补牙、保险与付款以及后续预约，通过真实场景对话和重点表达，帮助你提前熟悉看牙流程，更自然地听懂和沟通。
